svg.text: A COLOUR FOR EVERY KIND OF BLOCK
The six kinds' colours as they are, and two to pick for DUPLEX and NO CLASS, on each paint.
Duplex the red the hues left free; no class a light sand, apart by its lightness. DUPLEX #962339 NO CLASS #cba553
As 1, the light one a mint. DUPLEX #962339 NO CLASS #62b995
As 1, the light one a sky blue (nearest the sink's teal of the three). DUPLEX #962339 NO CLASS #419fc0
Duplex a deep magenta, between MONITOR's violet and MIDI's plum. DUPLEX #73348d NO CLASS #cba553
